title: `AppendCheckpointTrailer` can emit a trailer the final-block parser (and git) reject

worker.report:
I fixed the writer so it no longer joins a new trailer onto an indented, trailer-shaped paragraph. The narrow test passes, and `gofmt` reports nothing. I didn't run the new test against the old code, so I haven't seen it fail first.

`appendTrailerLine` now collects the final paragraph as raw lines, still skipping comment lines. It joins directly only when a new `isTrailerBlock` check passes and a blank line sits above the paragraph. That check needs at least one real trailer line, and every other line must be an indented continuation of one. The indented `Entire-Checkpoint: A` case now gets a blank line before B. A trailer whose last line is an indented continuation, like the `Signed-off-by:` example, no longer gets split into two blocks.

I did not extract `finalTrailerBlock`'s loop into the shared helper as the issue proposed. In this checkout `finalTrailerBlock` still uses the older trailer-only grammar, with no continuation support. The strict `ParseCheckpointFromFinalTrailerBlock` parsers from #2253 don't exist here either, so the test covers the writer's output only, with no writer/reader roundtrip.

The new test has three cases (space-indented, tab-indented, and a trailer with a continuation line).

Test: `TestAppendCheckpointTrailer_IndentedTrailerLikeParagraph`
Files: `cmd/entire/cli/trailers/trailers.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/trailers/append_indented_test.go`
